q1: SELECT bar FROM Serves GROUP BY bar HAVING COUNT(beer) >= 5
q2: SELECT S.BAR FROM SERVES AS S GROUP BY S.BAR HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT S.BEER) > 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT bar FROM Serves GROUP BY bar HAVING COUNT(beer) >= 5
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT S.BAR FROM SERVES AS S GROUP BY S.BAR HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT S.BEER) > 1
counterexample: INSERT INTO Bar (name, address) VALUES ('The Pub', '123 Main St'); INSERT INTO Beer (name, brewer) VALUES ('IPA', 'Brewery A'), ('Stout', 'Brewery B'); INSERT INTO Serves (bar, beer, price) VALUES ('The Pub', 'IPA', 5.00), ('The Pub', 'Stout', 4.50);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects bars that serve at least 5 different beers, while Q2 selects bars that serve more than 1 distinct beer.
counterexample_dsp: A bar that serves exactly 2 different beers.
